eventMetadata.context_description: The Philadelphia 76ers and Boston Celtics headlined a thrilling first-round Eastern Conference playoff series tied 3-3 entering Game 7 on May 2 at TD Garden, with Philly's 106-93 Game 6 rout—capping a comeback from a 3-1 deficit—fueling trader sentiment toward their upset potential despite Boston's home-court edge and superior 56-26 regular-season mark against the 76ers' 45-37. Joel Embiid returned probable post-appendectomy, complementing Tyrese Maxey's availability and Paul George's scoring surge, while Jayson Tatum's Game 6 knee stiffness sparked uncertainty, listed as questionable before reports confirmed his status. Both squads otherwise healthy per official injury reports, the matchup hinged on Boston's depth versus Philly's momentum in this rivalry renewed by a 2-2 regular-season split.

title: QatarEnergy announces/resumes LNG production in Qatar by April 30?
description:
QatarEnergy, a Qatari state-owned petroleum company, announced on March 2 that it would halt production of liquefied natural gas (LNG) due to military strikes on its operating facilities (see: https://www.qatarenergy.qa/en/MediaCenter/Pages/newsdetails.aspx?ItemId=3892).

This market will resolve to “Yes” if QatarEnergy resumes production of liquefied natural gas at QatarEnergy LNG production facilities in Qatar, or officially announces that such production has resumed or will resume, by April 30, 2026, 11:59 PM ET. Otherwise, this market will resolve to “No”.

QatarEnergy resuming the production of other halted products, including downstream LNG-related products, or resuming transportation of LNG without resuming production, will not alone count.

An official announcement that LNG production will resume at QatarEnergy LNG production facilities in Qatar must signal the end of the total LNG production halt effective immediately or on a specific date or clearly defined time window. Mere statements that production will resume at some undefined point in the future, or that production will resume once the halt has ended, will not count.

The primary resolution source for this market will be official information from QatarEnergy (https://www.qatarenergy.qa/en/Pages/vHome.aspx); however, a consensus of credible reporting may also be used.

eventMetadata.context_description: QatarEnergy's near-certain trader consensus at 99.9% Yes stems from rapid post-ceasefire progress after a March 2026 production halt at Ras Laffan LNG facilities triggered by missile attacks amid regional tensions. Reuters and Bloomberg reported on April 8 that the company mobilized engineers for restart, with sources confirming two of three trains at QatarEnergy LNG back online by mid-April, signaling partial resumption. Absent new disruptions like escalated military action or equipment failures, full ramp-up by April 30 aligns with expert estimates of weeks-long restarts to avoid damage. Ongoing North Field expansion underscores commitment, though force majeure declarations persist for affected contracts until normalized output.

eventMetadata.context_description: With the 48-team field finalized after late-March UEFA playoffs that saw Czechia, Sweden, and Türkiye secure spots, trader consensus crowns France at 16.4% implied probability for the 2026 FIFA World Cup title, edging Spain (15.3%) following Lamine Yamal's recent hamstring injury that clouds La Roja's attack despite their Euro pedigree and dominant qualifiers. England (11.1%), Argentina, and Brazil (both 8.6%) trail closely, buoyed by favorable group draws—France faces Norway, Senegal, and Iraq; Spain Uruguay, Saudi Arabia, and Cape Verde—under the expanded format where top two plus eight best third-placed teams advance from group stage. Squad depth, peak-age stars like Mbappé, and minimal injury disruptions keep the race tight among Europe's elite and South American powers.

This market will resolve to “Yes” if the Washington Wizards win the 2026 NBA Finals. Otherwise, this market will resolve to “No”.

This market will resolve to “No” if it becomes impossible for this team to win the 2026 NBA Finals based off the rules of the NBA.

The resolution source for this market will be information from the NBA.

eventMetadata.context_description: Oklahoma City Thunder lead trader consensus at 57.5% implied probability to repeat as NBA champions after posting the league's best 64-18 regular-season record and sweeping the Phoenix Suns 4-0 in the Western Conference first round, positioning them strongly for the semifinals against the Los Angeles Lakers. The San Antonio Spurs follow at 21.3% following their 62-20 campaign—their first playoffs since 2019—and a 4-1 first-round win over Portland, bolstered by Victor Wembanyama's return from a brief concussion absence. Eastern Conference contenders like the New York Knicks (8.0%, advanced 4-2) and Detroit Pistons (4.0%, atop East at 60-22) trail due to the West's dominance, with tight first-round series like Pistons and Celtics both at 3-3 underscoring regional parity but shorter championship paths. Recent second-round matchups and clean injury reports for top seeds sustain OKC's edge amid playoff momentum.

title: Eurovision Winner 2026
description:
This market will resolve to the country whose candidate for Eurovision 2026 wins.

If at any point it is impossible for the listed candidate to win Eurovision 2026 based on the rules of the competition (i.e. they are eliminated), this market may immediately resolve to "No".

If no winner is announced by July 31, 2026, 11:59 PM ET, this market will resolve "Other". All ties will be broken according to EBU's official Eurovision rules.

The primary resolution source for this market will be official information from Eurovision (https://eurovision.tv/), including live footage of Eurovision 2026, however a consensus of credible reporting will suffice.

eventMetadata.context_description: Finland's Linda Lampenius and Pete Parkkonen's violin-driven pop anthem "Liekinheitin," fresh off a commanding UMK national final win in late February, commands trader consensus at 34.1% implied probability, bolstered by dominant fan polls, OGAE votes, and bookmaker alignment signaling broad appeal for its unique staging potential ahead of first rehearsals this week. Greece's Akylas follows at 18.9% with the edgy, genre-shifting "Ferto" from Sing for Greece, gaining jury traction through pre-party buzz and Balkan televote prospects, while Denmark's Søren Torpegaard Lund's heartfelt ballad "Før vi går hjem" holds 12.4% despite post-pre-party concerns over live delivery. In this wide-open Vienna field at Wiener Stadthalle (semis May 12/14, final 16), staging reveals and vocal execution could spark rapid shifts in the skin-in-the-game sentiment.

eventMetadata.context_description: Gavin Newsom commands trader consensus at 26.4% for the 2028 Democratic presidential nomination, propelled by commanding leads in March California primary polls—his delegate-rich home state—and late April Echelon Insights data naming him Democrats' top pick for electability against figures like JD Vance. Kamala Harris trails at 10.2% despite national surveys showing her ahead and her April 10 National Action Network remarks teasing a run with strong Black voter applause, undercut by top Democrats' recent refusals to endorse her amid 2024 baggage. Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez's 8.3% reflects progressive buzz, Jon Ossoff's 6.5% a fresh Senate profile. Consolidation hinges on 2026 midterm results, fundraising, and early primary turnout in battlegrounds.

title: Elon Musk # tweets April 28 - May 5, 2026?
description:
This market will resolve according to the number of times Elon Musk (@elonmusk), posts on X from April 28 12:00 PM ET to May 5, 2026 12:00 PM ET.

For the purposes of this market, only main feed posts, quote posts and reposts will count.

Replies will NOT count towards the total - however, replies on the main feed such as https://x.com/elonmusk/status/1786073478711353576 will be counted by the tracker.

Deleted posts will count as long as they remain available long enough to be captured by the tracker (~5 minutes).

Community reposts which are not counted by the tracker not count toward the total.

The resolution source for this market is the 'Post Counter' figure for posts found at https://xtracker.polymarket.com. Individual posts can be viewed by clicking "Export Data". If the tracker does not update correctly in accordance with the rules, X itself may be used as a secondary resolution source.

This market will resolve according to the number of times Elon Musk (@elonmusk), posts on X from April 28 12:00 PM ET to May 5, 2026 12:00 PM ET.

For the purposes of this market, only main feed posts, quote posts and reposts will count.

Replies will NOT count towards the total - however, replies on the main feed such as https://x.com/elonmusk/status/1786073478711353576 will be counted by the tracker.

Deleted posts will count as long as they remain available long enough to be captured by the tracker (~5 minutes).

Community reposts which are not counted by the tracker not count toward the total.

The resolution source for this market is the 'Post Counter' figure for posts found at https://xtracker.polymarket.com. Individual posts can be viewed by clicking "Export Data". If the tracker does not update correctly in accordance with the rules, X itself may be used as a secondary resolution source.

eventMetadata.context_description: Trader consensus on Polymarket reflects a nail-biter race between 120-139 tweets (29.8% implied probability) and 140-159 (30.8%), driven by Elon Musk's current pace of 89 posts through 71% of the April 28 to May 5 window as of early May 3. This projects a mid-130s total if his recent daily average of ~18 holds, but volatility looms large—Elon's posting spikes unpredictably on viral political or Tesla threads, as seen in his May 1 high of 29, contrasted by May 2's quiet 9. Weekend slowdowns add uncertainty, with key catalysts in the final 48 hours to May 5 12:00 PM ET potentially tipping the scales via breaking news or engagement surges on X. Historical patterns show such markets hinge on last-minute momentum shifts.

title: Presidential Election Winner 2028
description:
The 2028 US Presidential Election is scheduled to take place on November 7, 2028.

This market will resolve to the person who wins the 2028 US Presidential Election. Otherwise, this market will resolve to “No.”

The resolution source for this market is the Associated Press, Fox News, and NBC. This market will resolve once all three sources call the race for the same candidate. If all three sources haven’t called the race for the same candidate by the inauguration date (January 20, 2029) this market will resolve based on who is inaugurated.

eventMetadata.context_description: Vice President JD Vance leads trader consensus at 21.1% implied probability for the 2028 presidential election winner, bolstered by recent GOP primary polling showing him at 53% nationally and a fresh boost in Republican voter support, alongside Iowa visits laying early primary groundwork amid 2026 midterm campaigning. California Governor Gavin Newsom follows closely at 17.6%, reflecting his prominence as a Democratic critic of the Trump administration, with head-to-head polls showing a tight 33-30% Vance edge. The fragmented field, including Marco Rubio at 10.1%, underscores the race's openness over two years out, hinging on 2026 midterm results, candidate announcements post-midterms, economic performance, and potential scandals to create separation among contenders.

eventMetadata.context_description: HHS Secretary Robert F. Kennedy Jr. holds a narrow 49% implied probability as trader consensus frontrunner for the 2028 Republican presidential nomination on Polymarket, edging Vice President J.D. Vance at 39.1% despite Vance leading recent CPAC (53%) and Yale Youth straw polls. This tight race reflects post-Trump succession uncertainty, with reports of President Trump distancing himself from Vance amid foreign policy setbacks like failed Iran negotiations, while RFK Jr.'s Make America Healthy Again agenda gains traction among the GOP base skeptical of big pharma. Secretary of State Marco Rubio trails at 21.1%, buoyed by diplomatic visibility. Key separators include Trump's endorsement signals, 2026 midterm results in battleground states, fundraising edges, and administration performance ahead of primaries.

title: F1 Drivers' Champion
description:
This market will resolve according to the listed driver that finishes 1st in the driver standings for the 2026 F1 season.

This market will resolve as soon as the official results of the final scheduled race of the 2026 F1 season are known.

If multiple drivers tie for first place in the drivers standings, this market will resolve according to the tiebreak procedure used by F1 to determine the 2026 F1 Drivers’ champion.

If at any point it becomes impossible for a listed driver to win the 2026 F1 Drivers Championship based on the rules of F1 (e.g., they are mathematically eliminated from contention), the corresponding market will resolve to “No”.

If the F1 season is permanently canceled or has not been completed by February 28, 2027, 11:59 PM ET, this market will resolve to “Other”.

The primary resolution source for this market will be official information from Formula 1.

eventMetadata.context_description: Mercedes' early-season dominance in the 2026 F1 Drivers' Championship has positioned Kimi Antonelli (75 points) and George Russell (68 points) as trader consensus favorites, with Antonelli's back-to-back victories in China and Japan—plus a podium in Australia—driving his 35.5% implied probability edge after just four events. Russell's consistent podiums, including a win Down Under, keep him at 28.5%, fueling a tight intra-team battle amid the Silver Arrows' superior pace in qualifying and race trim. McLaren's Miami upgrades propelled Lando Norris to Sprint victory and pole—the first non-Mercedes of the year—boosting his 9.3% odds and signaling challengers closing the gap, while Ferrari's Charles Leclerc (55 points) and Red Bull's Max Verstappen lurk with development potential in a marathon 24-race campaign.

title: Next French Presidential Election
description:
The next French presidential election is currently expected to be held around April 2027.  This market pertains to the outcome of the next French presidential election, regardless of whether it follows the scheduled end of the current term or is held earlier. 

The President of France is elected via a two-round system; a candidate must secure over 50% of the vote to win outright in the first round. If no candidate achieves this, the top two contenders advance to a runoff.

This market will resolve according to the candidate who wins this election.

This market includes any potential second round. If, for any reason, the results of the election are not known by December 31, 2027, 11:59 PM ET, this market will resolve to "Other".

This market will resolve based on the result of the election as indicated by a consensus of credible reporting. If there is ambiguity, this market will resolve based solely on the official results as reported by the French Government, specifically the Ministry of the Interior (https://www.interieur.gouv.fr/).

The President of France is elected via a two-round system; a candidate must secure over 50% of the vote to win outright in the first round. If no candidate achieves this, the top two contenders advance to a runoff.

This market will resolve according to the candidate who wins this election.

This market includes any potential second round. If, for any reason, the results of the election are not known by December 31, 2027, 11:59 PM ET, this market will resolve to "Other".

This market will resolve based on the result of the election as indicated by a consensus of credible reporting. If there is ambiguity, this market will resolve based solely on the official results as reported by the French Government, specifically the Ministry of the Interior (https://www.interieur.gouv.fr/).

The President of France is elected via a two-round system; a candidate must secure over 50% of the vote to win outright in the first round. If no candidate achieves this, the top two contenders advance to a runoff.

This market will resolve according to the candidate who wins this election.

This market includes any potential second round. If, for any reason, the results of the election are not known by December 31, 2027, 11:59 PM ET, this market will resolve to "Other".

This market will resolve based on the result of the election as indicated by a consensus of credible reporting. If there is ambiguity, this market will resolve based solely on the official results as reported by the French Government, specifically the Ministry of the Interior (https://www.interieur.gouv.fr/).

eventMetadata.context_description: Recent polls after March 2026 municipal elections position National Rally leader Jordan Bardella as first-round frontrunner at 38% in Elabe and OpinionWay surveys, buoyed by perceptions of RN strengthening and 75% of voters seeking major reforms amid hung parliament gridlock. Édouard Philippe trails closely at 18-25.5%, gaining from Le Havre mayoral reelection and proving strongest in runoffs, defeating Bardella 52-48%. Trader consensus reflects this tight race in a crowded field of dozens, with Marine Le Pen's eligibility appeal pending summer 2026 and left-wing calls for primaries fragmenting support. Senatorial elections in September and economic pressures on immigration, debt could widen gaps.

title: Elon Musk # tweets May 5 - May 12, 2026?
description:
This market will resolve according to the number of times Elon Musk (@elonmusk), posts on X from May 5 12:00 PM ET to May 12, 2026 12:00 PM ET.

For the purposes of this market, only main feed posts, quote posts and reposts will count.

Replies will NOT count towards the total - however, replies on the main feed such as https://x.com/elonmusk/status/1786073478711353576 will be counted by the tracker.

Deleted posts will count as long as they remain available long enough to be captured by the tracker (~5 minutes).

Community reposts which are not counted by the tracker not count toward the total.

The resolution source for this market is the 'Post Counter' figure for posts found at https://xtracker.polymarket.com. Individual posts can be viewed by clicking "Export Data". If the tracker does not update correctly in accordance with the rules, X itself may be used as a secondary resolution source.

title: Will the Iranian regime fall by May 31?
description:
This market will resolve to "Yes" if the Islamic Republic of Iran’s current ruling regime is overthrown, collapsed, or otherwise ceases to govern by May 31, 2026, 11:59 PM ET. Otherwise, this market will resolve to “No”.

This requires a broad consensus of reporting indicating that core structures of the Islamic Republic (e.g. the office of the Supreme Leader, the Guardian Council, IRGC control under clerical authority) have been dissolved, incapacitated, or replaced by a fundamentally different governing system or otherwise lost de facto power over a majority of the population of Iran. This could occur via revolution, civil war, military coup, or voluntary abdication, but only qualifies if the Islamic Republic no longer exercises sovereign power.

Routine political events such as elections, reforms, or leadership succession do not qualify. Internal coups or power shifts that preserve the Islamic Republic’s core structures also do not qualify. Only a clear break in continuity—such as a new provisional government, revolutionary council, or constitution replacing the Islamic Republic will qualify.

Partial loss of territory or challenges from rebel or exile groups will not qualify unless the Islamic Republic no longer administers the majority of the Iranian population within Iran. 

The resolution source will be a consensus of credible reporting.

eventMetadata.context_description: Trader consensus at 97.5% "No" for the Iranian regime falling by May 31 reflects its post-war stabilization, with IRGC elements consolidating de facto control after Supreme Leader Ali Khamenei's assassination in early 2026 strikes and a seamless transition to son Mojtaba. Nationwide protests sparked by economic crisis were quashed in April via massive crackdowns, restoring order despite ongoing US "Economic Fury" sanctions, naval blockade, and Strait of Hormuz disruptions. Recent diplomacy—Tehran's unacceptable ceasefire proposal rejected by President Trump on May 2—shows no momentum for overthrow. With loyal security forces and just weeks remaining, rapid collapse faces high barriers, though renewed airstrikes, mass defections, or reignited unrest could shift odds.

eventMetadata.context_description: WTI crude oil prices have surged above $105 per barrel in early May 2026 amid Strait of Hormuz supply disruptions and speculation over UAE's potential OPEC+ exit, before pulling back to around $102 on May 1 on hopes for a US-Iran ceasefire easing tensions. US inventories posted a sharp draw of 6.2 million barrels for the week ending April 29 per EIA data, supporting near-term tightness despite OPEC+'s modest 206,000 barrels per day output quota hike for May. Global forecasts from IEA and EIA signal softening demand growth averaging under 1 million bpd in 2026 amid economic headwinds, pointing to potential surpluses later. Traders eye weekly API/EIA inventory reports—with the next EIA due May 6—and IEA's May 13 Oil Market Report for resolution catalysts as May progresses.

eventMetadata.context_description: With the Eastern Conference first-round series tied 3-3, Game 7 pits the injury-depleted Toronto Raptors against a healthy Cleveland Cavaliers squad at Rocket Mortgage FieldHouse. Raptors guards Immanuel Quickley (right hamstring strain) and forward Brandon Ingram (right heel inflammation) remain out, stripping Toronto of its starting point guard and top scorer, forcing reliance on RJ Barrett's clutch Game 6 heroics in a 112-110 overtime road win that erased a late Cavaliers lead. Cleveland counters with its full rotation intact, including Donovan Mitchell, James Harden, Evan Mobley, and Jarrett Allen, leveraging superior depth, home-court advantage, and frontcourt dominance despite recent closeout stumbles. Momentum favors the resilient Raptors, but health and rest edges tilt trader consensus toward the Cavaliers in this do-or-die matchup.

title: Elon Musk # tweets May 1 - May 8, 2026?
description:
This market will resolve according to the number of times Elon Musk (@elonmusk), posts on X from May 1 12:00 PM ET to May 8, 2026 12:00 PM ET.

For the purposes of this market, only main feed posts, quote posts and reposts will count.

Replies will NOT count towards the total - however, replies on the main feed such as https://x.com/elonmusk/status/1786073478711353576 will be counted by the tracker.

Deleted posts will count as long as they remain available long enough to be captured by the tracker (~5 minutes).

Community reposts which are not counted by the tracker not count toward the total.

The resolution source for this market is the 'Post Counter' figure for posts found at https://xtracker.polymarket.com. Individual posts can be viewed by clicking "Export Data". If the tracker does not update correctly in accordance with the rules, X itself may be used as a secondary resolution source.

title: US x Iran diplomatic meeting by...?
description:
This market will resolve to "Yes" if there is a diplomatic meeting between representatives of the United States and Iran by the listed date, 11:59 PM ET. Otherwise, this market will resolve to “No”.

A diplomatic meeting refers to a deliberate meeting between representatives of the listed countries who are acting in an official capacity and are authorized to engage in negotiation or diplomacy regarding US-Iranian relations on behalf of their governments. Meetings conducted indirectly, for example, through designated mediators, facilitators, or interlocutors acting with the knowledge and authorization of the relevant governments, will qualify. 

Brief greetings, chance encounters, or talks otherwise not deliberately aimed at diplomacy or negotiation will not count. 

The meeting must be in-person and must be publicly acknowledged by either government or reported by a consensus of credible media. Remote meetings, phone calls, or other meetings where the relevant parties are not present will not count.

The resolution sources for this market will be official information from the governments of the United States and Iran, and a consensus of credible reporting.

eventMetadata.context_description: US-Iran peace negotiations have stalled after President Trump expressed dissatisfaction with Tehran's latest proposal to de-escalate Gulf tensions without immediate nuclear restraints, as reported on May 1. Following the first high-level talks since 1979 in Islamabad during mid-April—mediated by Pakistan and involving US Vice President Vance—discussions over reopening the Strait of Hormuz, ceasefire extensions, and postponing nuclear talks failed to yield a deal, driving up oil prices amid impasse. Iranian officials prefer mediated formats over direct meetings, while backchannel diplomacy continues for potential second rounds. Traders should watch for announcements on resumed summits or envoys like Witkoff and Kushner, as rapid shifts in ceasefire status or proxy escalations could alter trajectories before key deadlines.

title: US x Iran permanent peace deal by...?
description:
This market will resolve to “Yes” if Iran and the United states agree to a permanent peace deal by the specified date, 11:59 PM ET. Otherwise, this market will resolve to “No”. 

A permanent peace deal refers to any agreement which explicitly indicates that military hostilities between the United States and Iran have ended or will permanently cease, or uses equivalent language clearly signaling a lasting end to military hostilities between the United States and Iran. Agreements that are explicitly temporary or which do not include a definitive agreement to end military hostilities between the US and Iran on a lasting basis (e.g. a temporary extension of the two-week ceasefire agreement announced on April 7, 2026), will not qualify.

A qualifying agreement will be considered to have been established if either of the following conditions are met:

- The United States and Iran each sign or formally adopt a written agreement (e.g. a treaty or multi-point agreement) which meets the above criteria.

- Both the governments of the United States and Iran provide clear public confirmation that a qualifying agreement has been definitively established. Negotiations, statements of progress, or other statements which do not constitute a definitive announcement that a qualifying agreement has been reached will not count.

The primary resolution source for this market will be official information from the governments of the United States and Iran; however, a consensus of credible reporting may also be used.

title: Trump announces US blockade of Hormuz lifted by...?
description:
On April 12, 2026, President Donald Trump announced that the United States will blockade the Strait of Hormuz. You can read more about that here: https://www.nbcnews.com/world/iran/live-blog/live-updates-us-iran-fail-reach-deal-peace-talks-day-negotiations-rcna315918.

This market will resolve to "Yes" if President Trump, the US government, or the US military publicly and officially announces the end of the United States blockade of the Strait of Hormuz by the specified date, 11:59 PM ET. Otherwise, this market will resolve to "No."

Qualifying statements must clearly and explicitly indicate that the United States has lifted, ended, or will lift or end its blockade of the Strait of Hormuz on a specified date or use equivalently definitive language unambiguously signaling that such blockade has ceased or is set to cease on a specified date (e.g., statements unambiguously indicating that US naval activity in the relevant area has ceased will qualify). 

Statements that merely describe actions inconsistent with the blockade (e.g., "Iran resumed shipping through the Strait of Hormuz") without explicitly indicating the blockade as lifted will not alone suffice.

Informal announcements, statements from unnamed sources, or leaks do not qualify.

Written public statements from Donald Trump (e.g., posts from his personal Truth Social account) will qualify. Videos posted on his social media accounts will also qualify for a "Yes" resolution.

The primary resolution source for this market will be official statements from the US government and/or its official representatives; however, a consensus of credible reporting may also be used.

Note: this market will resolve solely based on whether a qualifying announcement is made within the specified timeframe. Whether the blockade is effectively enforced or whether maritime traffic resumes absent a qualifying announcement will not be considered.

eventMetadata.context_description: President Trump's April 12 announcement of a U.S. naval blockade on the Strait of Hormuz—targeting Iranian ports and vessels paying Tehran tolls—remains in full effect three weeks later, following the collapse of Islamabad peace talks amid the 2026 Iran conflict. In the past 48 hours, the administration warned shipping firms of sanctions for Iranian toll payments, while Trump likened U.S. Navy enforcement to "pirates" and called the blockade "profitable," rejecting Tehran's latest proposals short of a nuclear deal. No lifting announcement has occurred, with traders pricing in prolonged economic pressure on Iran via oil export disruptions; upcoming diplomatic signals or escalation risks, such as retaliatory actions, could influence resolution timelines.

title: Brazil Presidential Election
description:
A presidential election is scheduled to take place in Brazil on October 4, 2026.

This market will resolve according to the listed candidate that wins this election.

This market includes any potential second round. If the result of this election isn't known by June 30, 2027, 11:59 PM ET, the market will resolve to "Other".

This market will resolve based on the result of the election as indicated by a consensus of credible reporting. If there is ambiguity, this market will resolve based solely on the official results as reported by the Brazilian government, specifically the Superior Electoral Court (Tribunal Superior Eleitoral, TSE) (e.g., https://dadosabertos.tse.jus.br/).

eventMetadata.context_description: Trader consensus on Polymarket reflects recent polls showing Senator Flávio Bolsonaro slightly ahead of President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva in simulated second-round matchups for Brazil's October 4 first-round presidential election, with surveys like AtlasIntel/Bloomberg, Datafolha, and Nexus/BTG from late April indicating ties or narrow Flávio leads amid voter polarization between PT loyalists and Bolsonaro family supporters. Flávio's rise leverages his father's enduring right-wing base despite Jair Bolsonaro's imprisonment, while Lula maintains incumbency advantages but faces scrutiny over economic challenges and a Congress override of his veto reducing Jair's sentence on April 30. The fragmented field, including governors like Romeu Zema and Ratinho Júnior, keeps the race tight; separation could emerge from candidate registrations by August, economic data releases, or scandals before the runoff.

eventMetadata.context_description: With the Eastern Conference first-round series tied 3-3, Detroit Pistons host Orlando Magic in a winner-take-all Game 7 on home court, where the top seed benefits from crowd support and historical playoff edge. Pistons seized momentum by winning the last two games, including a stunning 93-79 Game 6 road comeback from 24 points down behind Cade Cunningham's late dominance, exposing Orlando's offensive cold streak. Magic face roster challenges with Franz Wagner ruled out (right calf strain, missing third straight game) and Jonathan Isaac out (left knee), thinning their frontcourt depth around Paolo Banchero. Detroit lists Kevin Huerter (left adductor) and Jalen Duren (hand) as questionable per latest injury reports, but their rest advantage and defensive form shape trader consensus toward the hosts in this high-stakes elimination matchup.

title: US obtains Iranian enriched uranium by...?
description:
This market will resolve to “Yes” if the US government or military officially announces or confirms that it has gained possession of any quantity of enriched uranium previously controlled by Iran by May 31, 2026, 11:59 PM ET. Otherwise, this market will resolve to “No”.

“Possession” means that the United States has actual physical custody or control of the enriched uranium, whether held within U.S. territory or elsewhere. Announcements of deals, agreements, commitments, or plans under which the United States would acquire possession of Iranian enriched uranium at a later time will not qualify.

Qualifying possession of Iranian enriched uranium may be acquired through any means, including through an agreed surrender or seizure.

A widespread consensus of credible reporting that the United States has gained possession of Iranian enriched uranium will also qualify for a “Yes” resolution, even if the United States makes no formal announcement.

The primary resolution source for this market will be official information from the government of the United States; however, a widespread consensus of credible reporting may also be used.

eventMetadata.context_description: Following recent IAEA reports confirming Iran's highly enriched uranium stockpile—estimated at around 440-1,000 kg of 60% purity, sufficient for multiple nuclear weapons—remains largely at the Isfahan complex despite 2026 U.S. and Israeli strikes, trader sentiment hinges on stalled post-war diplomacy. President Trump's administration has demanded the stockpile's handover, proposing $20 billion in frozen funds in exchange, but Iranian lawmakers insist enriched uranium will not leave the country, rejecting U.S. terms as excessive. Logistical challenges for physical seizure, including special forces operations discussed in March, add risks amid ceasefire talks. Upcoming negotiations or IAEA inspections could shift dynamics before key deadlines like May 31 or December 31.

title: 2026 Seoul Mayoral Election Winner

eventMetadata.context_description: Democratic Party candidate Chong Won-o, former three-term Seongdong-gu district head, commands trader consensus at 87.5% implied probability for the June 3 Seoul mayoral election following his April 9 primary win and double-digit leads in post-nomination polls, including 45.6% to incumbent Oh Se-hoon's 35.4% in late April surveys and 48% in a recent MBC poll. Recent developments like candidate registrations on April 27, policy clashes over housing deregulation, single-homeowner tax protections, and public health platforms have amplified Chong's momentum and party unity in swing districts. Oh trails at 12.5% despite incumbency advantages, with low chances for others as major nominees dominate; late-breaking scandals, voter turnout, or presidential approval shifts could narrow the gap.

title: LoL: KT Rolster vs HANJIN BRION (BO3) - LCK Rounds 1-2
description:
This market refers to the LoL match between KT Rolster and HANJIN BRION in the LCK Rounds 1-2, initially scheduled for May 3 at 4:00AM ET.

This market will resolve to "KT Rolster" if KT Rolster win the match against HANJIN BRION.

This market will resolve to "HANJIN BRION" if HANJIN BRION win the match against KT Rolster.

If the match is canceled (not played at all), ends in a tie, or is delayed beyond 7 days from the scheduled date without a winner determined, this market will resolve to 50-50. 

If the match begins but is not completed, and one team wins due to the opponent's forfeiture, disqualification, or walkover, this market will resolve to the team who wins. 

If the match ends in a forfeit, disqualification, or walkover (team withdraws before the start and the other wins automatically), this market will resolve to 50-50. 

The resolution source for this market will be official information from https://gol.gg/esports/home. However, if https://gol.gg/esports/home has not published final results within 2 hours after the event’s conclusion, a consensus of credible reporting may be used instead including video evidence.

In cases where a team’s listed name includes minor discrepancies from the resolution source, this market will resolve based on the underlying real-world match rather than exact name matching. Recognizable abbreviations, alternate or erroneous spellings, sponsor tags, affiliate or academy designations, regional identifiers, and minor formatting differences will be treated as referring to the same team, provided the intended team can be clearly and uniquely identified within the relevant competition. If a listed team name has no reasonable connection to any participating team, or if it matches or could reasonably refer to another team in the same competition such that the intended team cannot be unambiguously determined, this market will resolve 50-50.

eventMetadata.context_description: KT Rolster approaches this LCK Rounds 1-2 BO3 matchup as the clear favorite against bottom-ranked HANJIN BRION, backed by an 8-1 regular season record and strong macro execution from stars like top laner PerfecT, jungler Cuzz, and midlaner Bdd, despite a recent 0-2 loss to Hanwha Life Esports on April 29 that snapped their win streak. BRION languishes at 2-7 with inconsistent teamfights and laning, leaning on veteran ADC Teddy amid roster tweaks like midlaner Roamer's integration. Split LCK Cup results earlier this year add upset potential, but KT's superior standings, recent form, and objective control tilt trader sentiment heavily in their favor for a bounce-back win.

title: Fed Decision in June?
description:
The FED interest rates are defined in this market by the upper bound of the target federal funds range. The decisions on the target federal funds range are made by the Federal Open Market Committee (FOMC) meetings.

This market will resolve to the amount of basis points the upper bound of the target federal funds rate is changed by versus the level it was prior to the Federal Reserve's June 2026 meeting.

If the target federal funds rate is changed to a level not expressed in the displayed options, the change will be rounded up to the nearest 25 and will resolve to the relevant bracket. (e.g. if there's a cut/increase of 12.5 bps it will be considered to be 25 bps)

The resolution source for this market is the FOMC’s statement after its meeting scheduled for June 16-17, 2026 according to the official calendar: https://www.federalreserve.gov/monetarypolicy/fomccalendars.htm.

The level and change of the target federal funds rate is also published at the official website of the Federal Reserve at https://www.federalreserve.gov/monetarypolicy/openmarket.htm.

This market may resolve as soon as the FOMC’s statement for their June meeting with relevant data is issued. If no statement is released by the end date of the next scheduled meeting, this market will resolve to the "No change" bracket.

eventMetadata.context_description: Polymarket traders, wagering real capital, price a 95.5% implied probability of no Federal Reserve rate change at the June 16-17 FOMC meeting, reflecting consensus around persistent inflation and a resilient labor market. The April 28-29 FOMC held the federal funds rate steady amid March 2026 CPI inflation accelerating to 3.3% year-over-year—above the 2% target—and nonfarm payrolls adding 178,000 jobs, signaling no urgent need for easing. Hawkish Fed communications underscored data-dependent policy, pricing out near-term cuts. Realistic challenges include softer-than-expected April CPI on May 12 or weakening May nonfarm payrolls, potentially reviving 25 basis point cut odds now at 3.8%.
